claims.claim: The maintained source passes its repository preflight and regression suite under the documented development environment.
claims.oracle: Repository-controlled preflight and Node test suite
claims.falsifier: The documented preflight or regression suite fails for the tested revision/environment.
limitations: Repository-controlled tests are not an independent security review or production qualification.

claims.claim: Real-provider security, resource, and recovery behavior is sufficient for production deployment.
claims.falsifier: Any unresolved provider, isolation, resource, recovery, or threat-model failure rejects the claim.
limitations: Independent security review and complete real-provider qualification are not registered.
